skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Book Reader
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Book Reader. Traditional Victorian textiles and tailoring, every cut made by the hands of craftsmen, its custom-made monochrome cloth premium without being conspicuous.
skins.quote: Status and wealth can be whisked away overnight, but the thick coverage brought by knowledge lets him stride firmly towards the future.

skins.name: Dark Cloud
skins.content: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Dark Cloud. Mountain's attire at his parents' funeral. Though he personally slew his own enemy, there is no hint of joy in his heart. There are still things he needs to do.
skins.usage: One of Mountain's outfits for crucial moments.
skins.quote: 'I apply to withdraw from Rhodes Island. You've helped me plenty enough, and I will not implicate you all in what I am to do next.'
